headline: Quantum Scaling: Dynamics, Coherence, and Limits
summary: Today's papers explore the subtle mechanics and practical bottlenecks of scaling quantum systems. Topics range from Lanczos-variance controls on Krylov complexity and orbital coherence memory in transport to strict measurement limits hampering quantum structural dynamics.

themes.title: Quantum Dynamics and Transport
themes.body: Theoretical analyses reveal how internal quantum states drive macroscopic behavior, from Lanczos variance dictating Krylov complexity in composite systems to self-consistent Maxwell feedback producing memory effects in orbital transport.

themes.title: Quantum Computing Bottlenecks
themes.body: Assessing variational quantum algorithms on classical mechanical problems exposes severe barriers, demonstrating that Pauli operator explosion and shot-noise overhead eliminate speedups for structural modal analysis.
